title: Benchmark result evidence row
description: Benchmark measurement attached to a Gaia skill as an evidence row. Benchmark provenance collapses to three Trust Magnitude lanes: verified (CI reproduced or verifier attested, 2.0x), reported (public claim or mirrored benchmark approved by a human gate, 1.0x), and rejected (blacklisted/disputed/no scoring, 0x). Legacy aliases remain accepted: ci-reproduced/verifier-attested → verified, mirrored → reported, pending/unknown/retired/candidate → rejected. Self-attested provenance is FOREVER rejected. Trust Magnitude computes final benchmark score internally; do not persist finalScore. Lifecycle fields are proposal metadata only; active is distinct from verified. Generic evidence on starless generic nodes uses the same assertion lifecycle without adding stars.

type.description: Fixed discriminator. Matched by the evidenceEntry allOf/if branch to gate the benchmark-only required fields.

source.description: Public URL where the benchmark run or report can be inspected (leaderboard entry, blog post, CI workflow run, arXiv paper). Mirrors evidenceEntry.source.

evaluator.description: GitHub username of the person who filed the evidence row. For CI-reproduced rows this is typically the workflow owner or a bot handle.

date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) the evidence was filed against the registry. Distinct from runAt (when the benchmark itself was run).

benchmarkId.description: Semver-ish identifier of the benchmark spec. Widened to accept humaneval@v1.0, humaneval/python@v1.0, swe-bench_verified@1.0, mmlu-5shot@2024-03. FROZEN — extensions require a major schema bump.

score.description: Raw score as reported by the harness, in the units named by `unit`. Interpretation is unit-specific: pass@1 is 0..1, pct is 0..100, elo is unbounded, etc.

unit.description: FROZEN enum of score units. Extending this list is a major schema bump — downstream leaderboard consumers switch on it.

runAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time (with timezone) the benchmark harness was executed. Feeds the freshness half-life calculation in Trust Magnitude. Must be an explicit UTC timestamp ending in Z; offsets and naive date-times are not accepted.

provenance.description: Benchmark evidence lane/provenance. verified: CI-reproduced or verifier-attested evidence (2.0x). reported: public claimed or mirrored benchmark evidence approved by the human gate (1.0x). rejected: blacklisted, disputed, pending, or otherwise no-scoring evidence (0x). Legacy aliases ci-reproduced/verifier-attested normalize to verified; mirrored normalizes to reported; pending normalizes to rejected. self-attested is intentionally absent and FOREVER rejected.

attestor.description: Attestor or public source for benchmark-result evidence. For verified: verifier username or workflow run URL plus commit SHA. For reported: public claim, blog post, or leaderboard URL accepted by the human gate. Required for verified/reported rows.

datasetHash.description: SHA-256 (64 lowercase hex chars) of the raw dataset used for evaluation. Locks the row to a specific dataset version — a dataset revision produces a different hash, and thus a different row.

benchmarkInputHash.description: SHA-256 (64 lowercase hex chars) of the concatenation of (dataset + prompt template + harness config). Reproducibility fingerprint — a downstream verifier can re-run the harness with the same inputs and expect the same score. Different concept from datasetHash: two rows may share datasetHash but differ in benchmarkInputHash if the harness config or prompt template changed.

percentile.description: Optional placement percentile (0..100) within the field of published scores on this benchmark. Trust Magnitude uses percentile when present; otherwise it normalizes score by unit.

harnessUrl.description: Optional URL to the exact harness code used to produce the score. For CI-reproduced rows this is typically a permalink into scripts/benchmarks/<benchmark>/run.py at the pinned commit.

evidenceId.description: Stable identifier for this evidence item, preserved across revisions and metric refreshes (RFC #2148 §3.3).

revision.description: Positive integer revision number for this evidence assertion (RFC #2148 §3.3).

supersedes.description: Immutable reference to the revision number this assertion replaces, or omitted for initial revisions.

assertionState.description: Governed canonical assertion state under Yggdrasil IV lifecycle (RFC #2148 §3.2).

decisionRef.description: Reference recorded for a decision or migration; this field does not authenticate a human approval.

sourceRevision.description: Source revision/version observed, or "unknown" when unavailable.

observationState.description: Operational observation state from probe sensors (RFC #2148 §3.1).

lastObservedAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time of the last operational probe observation; distinct from substantive lastVerified. Must be an explicit UTC timestamp ending in Z; offsets and naive date-times are not accepted.

metricMethod.description: Measurement provenance method for raw metrics (Curation Authority Map §5).

contentDigest.description: SHA-256 digest of observed source content, or "unknown" when unavailable.

reviewedOldDigest.description: SHA-256 checksum of the previous payload; it detects stale data but is not approval authentication.

decisionHistory.description: Prior decision references retained across proposed lifecycle transitions; this record is not proof of human approval.

priorPayload.description: Complete prior evidence-row payload; proposal provenance only.

proposedBy.description: Untrusted proposal attribution, not authenticated reviewer identity.

proposedAt.description: UTC proposal timestamp, not an approval timestamp.

reviewedNewDigest.description: SHA-256 proposal checksum only; not a signature or evidence of human approval.

measurementScope.description: Scope of the raw measurement (for example repository, release, benchmark run); use "unknown" explicitly when unavailable.

lastVerified.description: Substantive evidence verification time; distinct from operational lastObservedAt and never refreshed by link-health observations.
